rows.title: USDC amount with three extra zeros

A careful treasurer reading '$250' would expect a payment of 250 units, not 250,000 units. This is a contradiction in amount.)

rows.title: Refund to a member, paid to an escrow
aiFindings: AI: "The refund is for alice-harbor.testnet." contradicts the action (The description claims the refund is for 'alice-harbor.testnet'. However, the FACTS show the money is transferred to 'escrow-harbor.testnet'. While the description says it is 'processed through' escrow-harbor, the phrasing 'Refund alice-harbor.testnet's... bond' strongly implies alice-harbor is the beneficiary/receiver of the refund. In DAO contexts, 'Refund X' usually means X receives the funds. If X does not receive the funds, but a third party does, the description is misleading or contradictory regarding who is empowered/received the money. The FACTS show only escrow-harbor received the money. If alice-harbor is not the receiver, the description 'Refund alice-harbor.testnet' is factually incorrect regarding the on-chain action's direct beneficiary.)
